card.name: Opening bracket before section cross-references
card.fires_on: The opening square bracket that starts a cross-reference such as [see Dosage and Administration (2.x)]. It comes at the end of a highlights sentence or heading, and sometimes before an age-group bracket.

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: Bracket after a drug or condition phrase, followed by 'see' and a section name with number.
modes.example: AVRETO in patients with severe or life-threatening hemorrhage<< [>>see Dosage and Administration (2.

modes.label: Population bracket
modes.description: Bracket after a study heading, before an age-group label such as Pediatric Patients.
modes.example: during the long-term schizophrenia studies. Schizophrenia<< [>>Pediatric Patients (13 to

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese words and unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the open bracket that introduces a 'see section X' pointer in a drug label summary.
